values.note: 2027 site charge: 20A back-in $36 weeknight, $47 July weekend; 30A back-in $45 weeknight, $58 July weekend. Add a ~3% park convenience surcharge and Campspot's $3 booking fee (all-in Tuesday 20A $40.06, 30A $49.32). Rustic tent sites and a site lock fee of $25 are separate.

sites.source: https://lakewapusun.com/stay/search (Campspot park 2420, 2027 dates read 2026-10-31) (30A back-in sites to 45 ft; 20A to 28 ft)

summary: Fees changed 38.21-49.32 -> 36-58 (2027 Campspot site charge; stored figures were all-in weeknight); season, 30A, water confirmed; booking, max rig, facilities added.
note: Large wooded campground in Amish country between Wooster and Loudonville (Shreve), around a 23-acre swimming/fishing lake and five smaller ones; mostly seasonal, but ~85 standard back-in RV sites (30A and 20A) are sold nightly, in the west block away from the lake - the lakeside sites are all seasonal. Jumping pillow, kayak/paddleboat rentals, dog park. --Claude
flags: PRIVATE gate facts: cheapest real RV night $36 20A weeknight ($40.06 all in), 2027; weekend 20A $47 site, $49.88-51.38 all in with Campspot's booking fee (which doesn't count); 30A weekend $58 site, over $50 but not the cheapest. Passes the gate on the 20A sites, which fit 28 ft.
